Suits walking, gym training and general fitness focused on natural movement.

en.tagline: Ultra-thin indoor training shoe with a double-closure system
en.intro: A minimalist training shoe built for maximum control, flexibility and ground connection during indoor workouts. An ultra-thin 4.5 mm sole with micro-traction lugs and articulated toes supports balance, while the double-closure upper locks the foot in place.

feats.d: An inner strap and outer cover keep the foot locked in and supported.
Micro-traction lugs add grip and flexibility.
Allow natural toe movement for balance and stability.
Offers reliable traction with a more sustainable material approach.
Best for weightlifting, strength work and circuit training.
